title: ONE LAST KISS

shots.name: 雨后的来路
shots.frame_prompt: Very wide establishing shot of a quiet coastal railway station and wet tracks beside a distant grey-blue sea, seen from beneath a simple platform shelter. No people. One small cream commuter train is far in the distance at the right edge. Dark rails lead diagonally into the image; a few amber lamps reflect in puddles. 28mm lens, eye level, generous empty sky.
shots.action_prompt: The distant train moves slowly farther along the coast. Puddles tremble in a light breeze, a few remaining raindrops fall from the shelter. A very slow lateral dolly follows the rails. No new train, no crowds, no sudden zoom.

shots.name: 窗边的她
shots.frame_prompt: Medium close-up of the woman in black dress and ivory neck scarf seated on the right of the frame beside a rain-streaked train window. Blue-grey city reflections occupy the left half. 50mm lens, soft warm practical light on her cheek, eyes looking outside.
shots.action_prompt: The train moves, city reflections drift across the glass. She breathes, blinks naturally, and slowly lowers her gaze toward the window reflection. A very gentle push toward her face. Lips relaxed; she is silent.

shots.name: 另一条街
shots.frame_prompt: Medium side view of the man in black knitted polo and black trousers walking alone beneath an old covered shopping arcade after rain. His face is in three-quarter profile, subject at the left third moving toward the right. Shuttered little shops, wet stone pavement and distant warm lights. 50mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: He walks four unhurried natural steps to the right. The camera tracks beside him at equal speed. His hands stay loose by his sides, clothing moves gently, gaze forward then briefly down. No posing or speaking.

shots.name: 留下的物件
shots.frame_prompt: Intimate still-life close-up: a small vintage silver-and-black 35mm rangefinder camera with a narrow black strap and two plain pale cinema ticket stubs on a dark wooden windowsill. The ticket backs are blank. Rain on the window, blue-grey city bokeh behind, one faint amber reflection. 85mm close focus.
shots.action_prompt: A water droplet slides slowly down the glass behind the camera. Distant lights drift softly, the loose end of the camera strap barely stirs in a breeze. A slow precise rack focus from raindrop to camera body. Objects stay still and physically unchanged.

shots.name: 午后的她
shots.frame_prompt: Medium close-up of the woman in cream square-neck knit and brown plaid skirt at the RIGHT side of a small worn wooden cafe table. She looks toward the LEFT, toward an offscreen companion. Sunlit old cafe with faded olive window frames, a small plant and cream ceramic cup. 50mm lens. Her forearms rest naturally below frame.
shots.action_prompt: She listens to her offscreen companion, her eyes brighten, and a small genuine closed-mouth smile grows. She briefly looks down at her cup then back left. Soft leaves move outside the window. Quiet natural acting, no dialogue or lip sync.

shots.name: 午后的他
shots.frame_prompt: Reverse medium close-up of the man in beige linen suit and cream open-collar shirt at the LEFT side of the same wooden cafe table, looking RIGHT toward his offscreen companion. Faded olive window frame, warm wood and blurred small plant. A cream cup at lower edge. Soft afternoon backlight, 50mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: He watches his companion with an easy closed-mouth smile, blinks and tilts his head a little, then lowers his gaze with a quiet amused breath. No talking. Restrained handheld camera drift, stable facial identity.

shots.name: 同一张桌子
shots.frame_prompt: Wide two-person shot of a small intimate cafe table by a faded olive-framed window. The man in beige linen sits on the LEFT, the woman in cream knit and plaid skirt on the RIGHT, facing each other. Two cream cups and one small silver-and-black film camera on the wooden table. Their hands rest separately on the table. Cozy lived-in cafe, nobody else prominent. 35mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: They share an unhurried warm glance and small natural smiles. The woman leans forward slightly as the man glances down at the film camera. Hands stay separate and anatomically stable. A slow subtle dolly inward. No dialogue, no kissing, no fast gesture.

shots.name: 海风回头
shots.frame_prompt: Medium full-body view of the woman in cream knit, brown plaid skirt and brown knee boots walking along a sunlit harbor promenade. Sea to the left, low stone railing to the right, old coastal buildings far behind. She is mid-stride, seen from a rear three-quarter angle, beginning to glance back over her shoulder. 50mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: She takes three relaxed steps, turns her head back toward the camera with a fleeting smile, then looks forward again. Breeze moves her hair and skirt hem gently. Camera follows at walking speed. Natural gait, no dancing or runway pose.

shots.name: 相机那一端
shots.frame_prompt: Medium shot of the man in beige linen suit beside the same harbor stone railing, pale blue-green sea behind him. A small silver-and-black rangefinder camera hangs from a narrow black neck strap at his chest. Both hands relaxed, one loosely touching the camera body. He looks toward a companion just beside the lens. 50mm lens, warm backlight.
shots.action_prompt: He smiles softly toward the offscreen woman, briefly looks down at the camera and gently steadies it with one hand. The camera remains hanging at his chest and is not raised to his face. Sea glitters and his jacket moves in a small breeze. Very slow camera drift.

shots.name: 空下来的位置
shots.frame_prompt: Wide shot of the SAME small cafe table beside a faded olive window frame, now empty at blue hour. Two unoccupied wooden chairs face each other, one cream cup left on the table, faint circular cup mark where the other cup stood. A dim amber interior light and rain-blue window. 35mm lens, composition recalls a couple having sat here.
shots.action_prompt: Locked camera with a nearly imperceptible push inward. Cool passing traffic reflections cross the window and empty chairs. A small plant leaf moves gently. No people appear, no ghostly figures or dissolves.

shots.name: 走下站台
shots.frame_prompt: Medium full-body view of the woman in the black sleeveless dress, ivory neck scarf and black knee boots walking alone along a nearly empty open-air railway platform. She is at the right third moving left. Wet platform floor, simple canopy pillars, sea-grey evening beyond. 50mm lens, head and boots inside frame.
shots.action_prompt: She walks steadily to the left with natural heel-to-toe steps. The camera tracks gently from the front side. Her scarf ends and hair move lightly. She looks ahead, does not address the camera. No other people approach her.

shots.name: 红灯之前
shots.frame_prompt: Medium close-up of the man in black knitted polo waiting at a quiet pedestrian crossing at blue hour. He stands on the left of frame, looking right across the road. Wet pavement and softly blurred distant red and green traffic lights, almost no pedestrians. 85mm lens, streetlight creates a gentle rim on dark hair.
shots.action_prompt: He waits, blinks, shifts his weight slightly, then looks up as the light changes. Soft reflected light changes subtly on his face. Camera remains quiet and close. He does not speak or smile at the camera.

shots.name: 错开的脚步
shots.frame_prompt: Low close-up from knee height of ONLY the black trouser legs and black loafers of the man taking a step across rain-wet road markings. His face and upper body are outside the image. A shallow puddle reflects an amber streetlamp. Cinematic 50mm lens, real wet asphalt texture.
shots.action_prompt: The same two feet make three slow natural walking steps across the shallow puddle, small realistic splashes and ripples. Camera tracks parallel low to the ground. Only one pair of legs, no morphing shoes or extra feet.

shots.name: 并肩的海岸
shots.frame_prompt: Wide rear view of the couple walking side by side along a sunlit seaside promenade. Man in beige linen suit on the LEFT, woman in cream knit and brown plaid skirt on the RIGHT, consistent heights and footwear. Low weathered stone wall, blue-green ocean, sparse seaside grasses, no crowds. 35mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: They walk away together at an easy natural pace, keeping their positions and a small comfortable gap. Their arms swing subtly without touching, hair and clothes move in the breeze. Camera follows slowly. No new people or outfit changes.

shots.name: 风里的笑意
shots.frame_prompt: Intimate close-up of the woman in cream knit, face turned slightly left toward an offscreen companion. Backlit dark hair, pale sea bokeh and a soft gold afternoon rim light. Her face is clearly the same woman, realistic skin, 85mm portrait lens, cinematic crop with whole forehead visible.
shots.action_prompt: A brief genuine smile reaches her eyes; she closes her eyes for a moment in the sea breeze, then opens them and looks left again. A few strands of hair cross her cheek naturally. No talking, no large mouth movements. Gentle camera drift.

shots.name: 他记住的瞬间
shots.frame_prompt: Intimate close-up of the man in beige linen suit, face angled slightly right toward his offscreen companion. Same harbor afternoon, sea and old pale buildings blurred behind. Natural relaxed smile, 85mm lens, soft side light.
shots.action_prompt: He holds a warm gaze toward the right, blinks and briefly drops his gaze with a small smile before looking up again. Wind moves a few hair strands and his shirt collar. Natural stable facial features, silent acting.

shots.name: 两张旧票
shots.frame_prompt: Macro close-up of two pale cream cinema ticket stubs placed side by side on a weathered wooden seaside bench beside a small silver-and-black rangefinder camera. Only blank backs of the tickets are visible, no readable writing or numbers. Warm sunlight, shallow depth, pale ocean beyond. 85mm macro.
shots.action_prompt: A light breeze lifts one corner of a ticket by a few millimeters and lets it settle again. Camera strap moves slightly, sunlight shimmers softly. Slow rack focus across the two tickets. No hands enter, no text appears.

shots.name: 跑向海边
shots.frame_prompt: Very wide lateral view of the couple on a long open seaside path above a low stone sea wall. Man in beige linen on left and woman in cream knit and plaid skirt on right, both full bodies seen at moderate distance. Their faces are small but their exact hair and clothing stay recognizable. Bright soft afternoon sea, plenty of sky. 35mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: They take a few playful light jogging steps together toward the right and slow to a walk. The camera pans gently with them. Natural human gait, no leaping, no complex choreography, no hand holding. Wind and waves remain continuous.

shots.name: 靠近一点
shots.frame_prompt: Medium two-person view of the couple seated on a simple weathered wooden bench overlooking the sea. The man in beige linen sits LEFT, woman in cream knit RIGHT. Her head rests gently on his shoulder, faces remain separate and anatomically natural. Their hands rest separately on their own laps. Soft late afternoon backlight. 50mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: They breathe quietly and stay close. She slightly settles her head on his shoulder; he looks out to sea and then gently down toward her without moving his body much. Hair stirs in the breeze. Slow restrained dolly closer, no kissing, no talking, no merging faces.

shots.name: 光落在海上
shots.frame_prompt: Wide contemplative shot of sunlight scattered across pale blue-green harbor water. A dark stone sea wall enters diagonally at the lower left, a few distant small fishing boats near the horizon. No people. 70mm lens, warm soft late afternoon, beautiful restrained specular highlights.
shots.action_prompt: Real small waves continuously roll and break gently against the stone wall. Sunlight sparkles change naturally on the moving water. Very slow lateral camera drift. No exaggerated surf, no drone swoop, no sudden new objects.

shots.name: 最后一晚的他
shots.frame_prompt: Medium close-up of the man in black formal tuxedo with white shirt and black bow tie, standing on the LEFT of an old cinema lobby. Muted burgundy curtain and warm amber wall sconce blurred behind. He looks RIGHT toward an offscreen companion, expression tender but thoughtful. 85mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: He keeps his gaze toward the offscreen woman, blinks slowly, takes one small breath and lets a restrained smile fade into thoughtfulness. His lips remain relaxed and silent. A subtle slow push in, no theatrical gesture.

shots.name: 最后一晚的她
shots.frame_prompt: Reverse medium close-up of the woman in black sleeveless dress and ivory neck scarf on the RIGHT side of the same old cinema lobby. Muted burgundy curtain and warm amber light, she looks LEFT toward an offscreen man. Same long dark hair and face, soft tender expression. 85mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: She holds his gaze, gives a very small closed-mouth smile, then slowly lowers her eyes and looks back up. Quiet breathing and a natural blink. Camera remains intimate and nearly still. No tears, no speech or singing.

shots.name: 中间的空座
shots.frame_prompt: Wide symmetrical view inside a small old cinema auditorium. Man in black tuxedo seated LEFT, woman in black dress and ivory scarf seated RIGHT, with exactly ONE empty burgundy velvet seat between them. They face toward an unseen screen, not the camera. Soft projection light brushes their faces, dim amber aisle lights, empty rows around. 35mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: Pale projection light fluctuates softly on their faces. She turns her eyes briefly toward him, while he keeps looking at the unseen screen. Then she looks forward again. Both breathe subtly; they remain in their own seats with the empty seat between them. Slow delicate push inward.

shots.name: 座位还在
shots.frame_prompt: Close-up of an empty burgundy velvet cinema seat. Two plain pale ticket stubs rest on its cushion, their blank backs facing up. Dark worn wooden armrests, soft amber aisle light, dust visible in a faint projection beam. 85mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: Camera slowly glides across the empty seat and tickets. The distant projection light gently flickers, a few dust particles drift in the beam. The tickets and seat stay fixed. No person or hand enters.

shots.name: 夜里的停顿
shots.frame_prompt: Close side view of the woman in black dress and ivory scarf standing at a dark harbor seawall at night-blue hour. Face on the right third looking left over the water. A very soft amber streetlamp lights one cheek, dark blue rippling water behind. Long dark hair visible, natural skin, 85mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: She closes her eyes briefly, takes a quiet breath, then opens them and looks steadily out to sea. Breeze moves a few strands of hair and the scarf ends. Slow steady push toward her face. No crying, no lip sync, no dramatic gestures.

shots.name: 灯下的他
shots.frame_prompt: Medium shot of the man in black knitted polo seated alone at a small wooden apartment table. A closed dark photo book and small silver-and-black film camera lie on the table, hands relaxed beside the book. One warm shaded lamp, faded green wall, distant blue window. He looks down. 50mm lens, intimate natural room.
shots.action_prompt: He slowly rests his palm flat on the closed photo book, pauses, then lifts his eyes toward the blue window. Quiet breathing and slight shoulder movement, no speaking. Objects keep the same shapes. Camera gently drifts closer.

shots.name: 底片与微风
shots.frame_prompt: Close-up of a short strip of developed 35mm photographic film hanging near a slightly open window in a quiet room. Tiny film frames show abstract blue-green coastal colors, not legible people or text. Dusk-blue window, warm amber lamp bokeh at one side, very shallow depth of field. 85mm macro.
shots.action_prompt: The film strip sways gently back and forth in a small breeze, tiny highlights travel along its glossy edge. Slow focus shift from sprocket holes to the soft colored frames. Natural pendulum motion, no morphing film or letters.

shots.name: 向天亮走去
shots.frame_prompt: Wide shot of the woman in black dress and ivory scarf walking alone along a long pedestrian bridge above a quiet harbor road. She is small at the lower right third, seen from behind. Blue-grey predawn sky begins to brighten at the horizon, wet bridge pavement, simple steel railings. 35mm lens, generous open space.
shots.action_prompt: She walks steadily away along the bridge. Her scarf and hair move lightly, distant traffic lights drift below. The camera follows with a slow level dolly, no drone rise, no extra people, no runway pose.

shots.name: 出口的光
shots.frame_prompt: Wide rear three-quarter shot of the man in black knitted polo and black trousers walking through a plain concrete pedestrian underpass toward a small pale-gold dawn exit. He is at the left third; worn walls, damp pavement and soft cool shadows. 35mm lens, clean restrained composition.
shots.action_prompt: He walks naturally toward the light for several steps, keeping the same body and clothes. The camera stays behind with a gentle forward track. His shadow moves on the damp floor. No extra figures or sudden scene changes.

shots.name: 把过去收好

A clean narrow sunbeam enters from an unseen window. Soft cream curtains blurred behind. 85mm close focus.
shots.action_prompt: The light curtain gently moves, causing a soft stripe of sunlight to shift across the camera and book. Dust floats naturally in the beam. Slow restrained rack focus from the tickets to the camera. No hands, no text, no morphing objects.

shots.name: 独自站在海边
shots.frame_prompt: Very wide seaside jetty shot at first light. The woman in black dress and ivory scarf stands alone on the LEFT third near the end of a broad safe stone promenade, several feet from the edge, facing the sea. Her whole body and boots visible, no railing or danger action. Open pale sky, calm water, distant coastal houses. 35mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: She stays safely on the wide promenade and slowly turns her shoulders a few degrees toward the morning light. Wind moves her scarf and hair, waves ripple below. A slow lateral dolly reveals more open sea. No jumping, no approaching the edge.

shots.name: 终于松开的表情
shots.frame_prompt: Close-up of the woman in black dress with ivory scarf, warm dawn light softly across her face, pale sea bokeh behind. She looks slightly left away from the lens. Same natural adult face and long dark hair. Restrained film portrait, 85mm lens, delicate highlights.
shots.action_prompt: She takes a quiet breath and her expression slowly eases into a tiny peaceful closed-mouth smile. Natural blink, gentle breeze in the hair. The camera holds on this change without a dramatic push. No crying or singing.

shots.name: 新的早晨
shots.frame_prompt: Medium full-body shot of the same woman now wearing her light periwinkle pinstripe blazer and short skirt, subtle silver star embellishments, narrow ivory-and-black neck scarf and cream boots. She walks along a sunlit tree-lined coastal city street after rain. Fresh pale morning light, modest shopfronts blurred, no readable signs. 50mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: She walks forward with an ordinary relaxed gait, glances toward the trees, and smiles slightly to herself. Camera tracks from her front side at the same pace. Her blazer and scarf move gently. No fashion posing, dancing, or outfit transformation.

shots.name: 他也继续生活
shots.frame_prompt: Medium close-up of the same man in beige linen suit and cream open-collar shirt standing at a small bookstore window in morning light. A closed book rests in his relaxed hands at waist height, face and shoulders in focus. Warm wood shelves blurred behind, no legible book titles. He looks out toward the bright street. 50mm lens.
shots.action_prompt: He looks up from the closed book toward the street, gives a very slight peaceful smile, and turns his upper body a few degrees as if ready to leave. Natural breathing. Hands keep the book stable; he does not flip pages or speak. Gentle camera drift.

shots.name: 路向远处延伸
shots.frame_prompt: Wide open coastal path in clear gentle morning light, low weathered stone wall and sea at the left, muted green seaside grasses and a few white wildflowers at the right. No people, no vehicles. Path leads toward a modest bright coastal town in the far distance. 28mm lens, calm generous space, restrained natural colors.
shots.action_prompt: The camera glides slowly forward along the empty path. Grasses and flowers move in the sea breeze, waves ripple and glint softly. No sudden new objects, no drone swoop, no time lapse.

shots.name: 走进下一天
shots.frame_prompt: Final very wide rear shot of the same woman in the light periwinkle blazer and skirt with cream boots walking away along a broad coastal promenade toward the sunlit town. She is small in the lower center, long dark hair and exact blue outfit recognizable. Pale sea to the left, simple stone wall and open bright sky. 35mm lens, quiet closing composition.
shots.action_prompt: She keeps walking steadily away for the whole shot, gradually becoming slightly smaller as the camera holds mostly still. Breeze moves her scarf and hair, sea sparkles gently. No turn back, no new person, no sudden zoom. Leave calm open space for the film to fade out at the end.

style: A frame from an understated contemporary Japanese romantic feature film. Real live-action photographic cinematography, naturally imperfect skin and fabric, soft optical halation, subtle fine 35mm grain, restrained exposure and color, no HDR or over-sharpening. Thoughtful off-center composition with foreground depth and negative space. Quiet observational camera, plausible physical space, no beauty advertising, no studio or character sheet, no collage, no illustration, no CGI. No text, letters, subtitles, signage, watermarks, logos, or black bars. Keep the supplied adult identities and exact wardrobes while replacing the studio setting completely.

palettes.present: After rain, a small lived-in Japanese coastal city at blue hour. Slate blue and grey shadows, dark wet pavement, restrained cream and amber practical lights, subdued natural skin. No saturated neon. Quiet, spacious, gently melancholic.
palettes.memory: A remembered afternoon in the same Japanese coastal town. Soft late-afternoon sunlight, pale blue-green sea, faded olive details, honey-colored wood, warm cream skin, delicate golden backlight. Warm but realistic, not orange-tinted or sepia.
palettes.evening: The last evening in an old neighborhood cinema. Muted burgundy velvet, aged dark wood, warm amber wall sconces, soft pale projection light. Intimate quiet photographic realism, deep shadows that still retain detail.
palettes.dawn: A clear morning after rain in the same coastal town. Gentle pale-gold sun, airy blue sky and sea, muted green leaves, light cream highlights, natural skin. Calm, hopeful, open space.

cut_alignment.method: nearest estimated musical pulse, then quantized to 24fps
